object_description: three low-rise pavilions arranged around a central schoolyard
design_condition: Three new buildings are placed around the historic building to follow the sloping terrain, frame a central schoolyard, and create varied indoor and outdoor spaces.

positive.statement: The precise placement of three single-story buildings sensitively responds to the site and its history.
The roof edges slope down with the same gentleness as the terrain.
The single-story arrangement and distribution of uses across different buildings are sensible and valuable for school operation.
The generous arrangement of indoor and outdoor spaces promises a calm and de-escalating atmosphere.
The wooden pavilion architecture is a calm and beautiful response to the landscape context.
The newly built pavilions create an amazing number of places to stay with very different qualities.

negative.statement: The space between the new houses and the main building appears somewhat narrow.
The interesting impression of buildings floating above the terrain is not sufficiently deepened in the outdoor-space design.
The schoolyard would tolerate more unsealed green areas and additional tree planting.
